title: 2008 AMC 12B Problem 3
statement: A semipro baseball league has teams with \(21\) players each. League rules state that a player must be paid at least \(\$15{,}000,\) and that the total of all players’ salaries for each team cannot exceed \(\$700{,}000.\) What is the maximum possible salary, in dollars, for a single player?

solutions.text:
One player earns the most when the other \(20\) players each receive the minimum salary of \(\$15{,}000.\)

Thus the maximum salary is \(\$700{,}000\) \(- 20 \cdot \$15{,}000\) \(= \$700{,}000\) \(- \$300{,}000\) \(= \$400{,}000.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: To make one salary as large as possible, pay the other \(20\) players the minimum allowed
The maximum is \(\$700{,}000\) minus the total of \(20\) minimum salaries
